title: Weekly Limits Promotion Ending August 19, 2026
description: The 50% higher weekly usage limit promotion that ran from May 13 through August 19, 2026 is ending, reverting to pre-promotion levels. Users discuss concerns about token consumption, model quality changes in Opus 5 and Fable 5, and comparisons with competitors.

community_feedback.quote: The promotion is ending; the limits are reverting to pre-promotion levels. From May 13, 2026 through August 19, 2026, your weekly usage limit in Claude Code is 50% higher.
I just cancelled my Max 5x plan. I was already mad at the limits, now Anthropic says it will get worse? Nah, thanks.
If they remove that extra 50%, I'm moving my $200 to Codex.
During this period however they've released models which lots of people report to be significantly more chatty.

I get incredible utility out of $200 per month. It's hard to put a number on it, but even accounting for all the time in meetings, talking with stakeholders and developers etc I'm over 10% more productive overall.

title: Version 2.1.238 Release (August 21, 2026)
description: Broad update with new prompt and runner settings (keybindingFlavor), tighter MCP and plugin security, more resilient Remote Control and cross-session messaging, improved startup speed and memory leak fixes.

title: Version 2.1.237 Release (August 20, 2026)
description: Fixed prompt caching for custom gateways and added built-in Concise output style for faster, result-first responses.

title: Version 2.1.236 Release (August 20, 2026)
description: Added default model setting, cross-session idle notifications, stronger macOS sandbox protections, improved auto mode, Remote Control, startup speed, and VS Code screen reader support.

title: Week 32 Update: Cross-Session Messaging & Self-Hosted Environments (August 7, 2026)
description: Added cross-session messaging allowing Claude sessions to message each other, self-hosted environments for cloud sessions on own infrastructure, auto mode becoming default for new CLI sessions, improved worktrees, plugins, sandboxing, and VS Code focus handling.

title: Cloud Agents & Cursor Harness Improvements (August 19, 2026)
description: Cursor announced automations for always-on cloud agents that can monitor PRs, watch Slack threads, and run scheduled tasks. Improved cloud agent harness enabling agents to work together as a coordinated system.

title: Origin Code Hosting (August 17, 2026)
description: New Origin Code Hosting feature launched.

title: Cloud Agents Start 3x Faster with Builds (August 13, 2026)
description: Cloud agent startup performance improved by 3x with build caching.

title: CLI Changelog Update (August 11, 2026)
description: CLI improvements including steering and subagents, skills/custom modes/goals, models, MCP and plugins, terminal and rendering, approvals and security.

title: Reported SpaceX Acquisition (August 14, 2026)
description: Reports of a $60 billion acquisition of Cursor by SpaceX, making Cursor a wholly-owned SpaceX subsidiary. Would be the largest acquisition in tech history if confirmed.

community_feedback.quote: SpaceX says it has agreement to acquire Cursor for $60B. Cursor's run rate is on track to surpass $6 billion by the end of 2026.
Cursor makes a ton of money on its AI IDE. What's crazy is that a company that sells an IDE (that's not even an original product, it's a VS Code fork) is worth $60B.
